svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: sum it up in numbers? 10+ years in IT, 3 U.S. embassies, 5 featured projects, 2 published mods And one README that types itself. Q: what's BloodHound? A local-first guide for dog owners. It turns flagged canine lab results into conservative nutrition notes and structured questions to bring to a vet. 40 biomarkers, 70+ breed profiles, 4 body systems, 0 accounts or uploads Deterministic rules, an explicit non-diagnostic scope, and no server-side health data. Live at bloodhound-nine.vercel.app. Q: hold on, airship mods? Two published mods for Create: Aeronautics, on CurseForge and Modrinth: procedural delivery contracts with physics-compiled cargo, and a preflight tool that simulates mass, lift, balance and thrust to…
